candidate.name: NACA 0012 experimental polar series
candidate.citation: Charles L. Ladson, Effects of independent variation of Mach and Reynolds numbers on the low-speed aerodynamic characteristics of the NACA 0012 airfoil section, NASA TM-4074, 1988
candidate.source_access: NASA metadata returned distribution PUBLIC and DOCUMENT_AND_METADATA on 2026-09-13. This does not substitute for checking rights on every redistributed excerpt or dataset.
candidate.source_scope: NASA metadata states Mach 0.05–0.36 and chord Reynolds number 3–12 million, with transition-fixing effects studied. These are source ranges, not selected production conditions.
candidate.selection_reason: Archival experimental campaign with explicit facility and variations of Mach, Reynolds number and transition. A matched full polar series can be predicted rather than selecting a favorable scalar.
candidate.distribution_tradeoff: Full matched polar series proposed. Cp(x/c) is not claimed available for the exact series until a custodian verifies it. This is an operating-condition distribution, not a spatial field.

candidates_considered.reason: Experimental, archival and parameterized; exact series, trip, corrections and uncertainty still require clean curation.

candidates_considered.reason: Rich spatial distributions, but tunnel blockage, incoming boundary layer and flow-control configuration introduce more reconstruction demands for the first challenge. Search results also exposed comparison outcomes to this planning task.

candidates_considered.reason: Already familiar local cases and code-to-code comparisons cannot establish a new blind experimental prediction.

exposure_log.material: Web search snippets included experimental/published-comparison numbers for TM-4074 and the NASA hump. No complete source paper was read or redistributed in this implementation task.
exposure_log.consequence: This task must not be reused as the blind predictor. A fresh isolated predictor must receive only reviewed inputs; canonical-model pretraining familiarity cannot be ruled out.
